title: Text you can name and reuse
idea: A string is text in quotes. Just like a number, you can store it in a variable and reuse it.

exercises.prompt: A 'string' is the programming word for what?
exercises.explanation: A string is just text. You've already used strings inside print — the words in quotes were strings all along.

exercises.prompt: Which of these is a string?
exercises.explanation: Text wrapped in quotes is a string. 42 is a number, not a string.

exercises.prompt: You can store a string in a variable, just like you store a number.
exercises.explanation: A variable can hold a string too. name = "Mia" remembers the text "Mia" under the name 'name'.

exercises.prompt:
What will this show?

name = "Mia"
print(name)
exercises.explanation: name holds the string "Mia". Printing name shows its value: Mia (no quotes on screen).

exercises.prompt:
What is the difference between these two lines?

print("name")
print(name)
options: The first shows the word name; the second shows what the variable name holds
exercises.explanation: Quotes mean 'this exact text'. No quotes means 'use the variable's value'. A tiny difference, a big effect.

exercises.prompt: A string can hold a whole sentence, with spaces.
exercises.explanation: One pair of quotes can hold a word or a long sentence. "See you tomorrow" is one string.

exercises.prompt:
Store the text Dailo in a variable called app, then print it.

app = ____
print(app)
exercises.explanation: The text goes in quotes on the right of the =. Now app holds "Dailo".

exercises.prompt:
What will this show?

greeting = "Good morning"
print(greeting)
exercises.explanation: greeting holds the whole string. Printing it shows: Good morning.

exercises.prompt: Build a line that stores the text yes in a variable called answer.
exercises.explanation: variable = "text". The quotes make it a string.

exercises.prompt: Why is it handy to store text in a variable?
options: You can reuse the same text many times by name
It turns text into a number
exercises.explanation: Name it once, use it everywhere. Change it in one place and every use updates. Same power as number variables.
